Scan with your phone to open Raineworks TV in the Marketplace. Download it, then restart Home Assistant.
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging, and Network debugging where it\'s a separate switch.
Then scan this to add the TV. Home Assistant lists the TVs it finds: pick this one (%1$s), then choose Allow here when the TV asks.
